name: New Zealand
summary: New Zealand has no official fictitious NZBN: the two NZBNs in the Peppol PINT A-NZ examples belong to real (removed) companies, and the NZ party data in those examples should not be copied. There is no reserved telephone range, so leave phone numbers out. Inland Revenue publishes the IRD and bank account algorithms with worked examples, but every valid IRD number may belong to a real taxpayer, so none is listed as usable. NHI numbers starting with Z are reserved for testing. NZ Post's examples put invented people at real places; no open postcode file exists to check against.

identifiers.name: NZBN (New Zealand Business Number)
identifiers.format: 13-digit GS1 GLN, all seen start with 9429
identifiers.authority: MBIE (NZBN Register), numbers from GS1 New Zealand
identifiers.notes: GS1 mod-10 check digit. The NZBN API sandbox mixes test cases with old real Companies Register data, so its NZBNs are not safe.

identifiers.name: IRD number
identifiers.format: 8 or 9 digits, shown nn-nnn-nnn or nnn-nnn-nnn
identifiers.notes: Valid range 10,000,000-200,000,000 (raised from 150,000,000 on 1 April 2026); mod-11 with weights 3 2 7 6 5 4 3 2, secondary weights 7 4 3 2 5 2 7 6 if the result is 10. The range check means a valid number is in the issued range and may belong to a real taxpayer. IR's test IRD numbers are only on the Gateway Services developer portal.

identifiers.name: GST number
identifiers.format: Same as the IRD number, usually shown nnn-nnn-nnn

identifiers.name: Bank account number
identifiers.authority: Payments NZ (Bank Branch Register); algorithm published by Inland Revenue
identifiers.notes: Weighted mod-11/mod-10 algorithms A, B, D, E, F, G, X chosen by bank ID (IR spec §7). NZ has no IBAN.

identifiers.name: NHI number (National Health Index)
identifiers.notes: Numbers starting with Z are reserved for testing. Not needed in UBL.
